title: ABC 00362157 (draft, pre-wired from open dataset)

source.note_units: ABC released files carry no unit key in meta/stats; meshes treated as nominal mm; every GT STL is scaled so max extent = 120 mm (scale_to_mm = 120/max_extent of the downloaded mesh). The watertight mesh STL is shipped only inside the archive.nyu.edu chunk archives (abc_<chunk>_stl2_v00.7z holds <id>_<guid>_trimesh_000.stl); per-file gh-pages URLs exist only for a few demo models.
source.coordinate_transform: xy-centred at origin, bbox min z translated to 0

selection.filters: watertight, 1 component, <50000 tri, volume>0, winding consistent, extent in [20,400] nominal mm

citation: ABC: A Big CAD Model Dataset For Geometric Deep Learning (Koch et al. 2019); copyright owned by the creators; Onshape Terms of Use 1.g.i.
notes: Reference measurements are informational only until the user draws a real doodle; the ink in source/drawing.png is a placeholder derived FROM the GT STL and must never be used for fidelity scoring.
